menu.title: 🎁 Giveaways
menu.description:
Create and manage giveaways from the web dashboard — a full form with every optional requirement.

• **Entry modes**: button or reaction (chosen per giveaway)
• **Requirements**: role, time in the server, account age, another server, blacklist
• **Automatic ending** with a uniform draw
• **Reroll** available after it ends
